projects.name: SpookyHash V2 (Bob Jenkins' official repo)
projects.lead: Bob Jenkins' own SpookyV2 repository (Mar 2026, Unlicense, C++ and Rust). The rurban/smhasher and SMHasher3 SpookyV2 rows measure Jenkins' reference C++ code, which this repo now hosts; the catalogue currently links an archived C port (g1mv/spookyhash). Report the SMHasher/SMHasher3 bulk and small-key numbers vs xxHash64/XXH3 with hardware, and anything the new repo itself publishes.

projects.name: LeMac (pauldreik C++20 port)
projects.lead: Maintained C++20 implementation of the LeMac MAC (ToSC 2024, corrigendum ToSC 2025(1)) with arm64 support; the catalogue's current LeMac entry is the authors' stale research code implementing the buggy LeMac-0. Report this port's own benchmark numbers against GMAC/GHASH or other MACs with hardware and compiler, and whether it implements the corrected LeMac.
